geometry.classification: geometry-derived branches and section centroids; 45%/75% phalanx division; thumb CMC halfway wrist to measured branch base plus MCP/IP section; UV skin-mask review; connected finger surfaces including glove-opening rim, smooth 9% joint / 9mm exposed-root windows are tuning, not scanned anatomy

tuning.contactSkinNote: reserved v32 value now applied to ragdoll contacts; not ballistic/hit thickness
tuning.latestUserCorrection: instant relaxed local finger pose fixed throughout ragdoll
tuning.gripCache: Idle plus11 TriggerOnly frames; per actor; interpolation only during play

grip.source: stationary common FPS rig after unchanged AK retarget: Idle@0 + native TriggerOnly frames; no new grip
grip.formula: hand-space source posed rotation times geometry-axis calibration, mapped by measured palm frame; equivalently mapped rest delta plus the source anatomical rest bend

performance.method: same Chromium SwiftShader; controlled60Hz simulation +/-10s600frames each; full GPU finish; not hardware FPS
